scope: Independent read-only final code and source-contract review. No builds, model execution, native capture, product edits or packaging execution were performed by the reviewer. Applies to the exact formatted file identities below.

resolved_findings.resolution: One file.metadata().len() sample is checked, converted to usize with a checked conversion and retained for try_reserve_exact. The bounded read and post-read check remain to reject later growth.

confirmed: Source option parsing ends at the first positional argument; importance loading happens before ftype interpretation.
Source table order and alias spelling control generated names; numeric 0 selects F32 before COPY; trailing arguments after the optional thread count are ignored.
Explicit split output removes the last five bytes whenever '.gguf' is anywhere in the path. Invalid UTF-8 boundary is an explicit unsupported path domain.
Empty metadata override keys terminate later overrides, including generated importance provenance.
Pruning preserves empty-token rejection, decimal-prefix conversion, sorting and deduplication.
GGUF importance counts use host-long ties-away rounding in a documented finite range; division uses per-count floor row widths; remainder values become +0 and nonpositive counts fill 1.
Legacy positive ncall divides as F32; nonpositive counts retain sums; optional partial little-endian chunk trailer and incomplete dataset handling match source.
GGUF final padding and tensor layout are checked; sums/counts require F32; activation reinterpretation never reads beyond its tensor.
Scalar and input lengths, entry/value counts and filter work are bounded. Filter errors cannot hide malformed loaded entries.

Correct IEEE hex rounding preserves the subnormal-to-min-normal carry; the original UCRT observation stays in rounding-correction.json, and independently captured public F32 metadata has exact signed-zero output hashes.

The Windows same_file helper uses the full FILE_ID_INFO volume and 128-bit identifier. Its repr(C) size, alignment, field offsets, BOOL/HANDLE widths and class number match the installed Windows SDK capture.
Both owned File handles remain live through their identity queries. Failed calls capture last_os_error before any handle is dropped; partial output is ignored.

OpenOptions access_mode(0) overrides read(true); READ|WRITE|DELETE sharing remains enabled. BACKUP_SEMANTICS permits directory handles, symbolic links are followed, and no exclusive-share lock probe or content comparison is used.

The only new model-quant dependency is a local path to the existing platform-loader crate. Maintained model-quant library and CLI entry point retain forbid(unsafe_code); the OS FFI is confined to platform-loader.

The CLI equivalence check occurs after source argument preparation and before conversion and skips dry runs. The library checks every published output against every input shard before writing and again before each rename.
Both original identity-v1 and directory-v2 captures record unchanged source, producer and pinned input identities. Destructive original writes were applied only to fresh external disposable copies.

Windows original alias writes return failure without changing the input. GNU original hard-link writes return success after modifying the input; same-path and symlink writes truncate input and terminate with SIGBUS. The Rust checked-error/preservation correction is explicit in CLI.md and fixture README.

Original public-C dry runs accept aliases and existing directory destinations on both hosts. The core now skips alias and directory rejection only for dry-run, with six retained direct core identity/dry-run scenarios per host.

The added core regression preserves every input, checks source success/failure observations, compares the distinct-file successful control against complete original bytes and checks for leaked staging files.
qualifications: Integer atol overflow and nonfinite/out-of-range lround domains are marked rust_boundary in original fixtures; they are checked rejections, not exact native-return claims.
The three recorded private F64 correction rows refer to the measured UCRT carry defect. Original output observations remain retained, and the public complete-file tests remain exact.
Source usage prose, build banners and timings are outside byte-exact CLI claims. Status, usage/dry-run/warning classes and complete output bytes are the maintained oracle contract.
The helper is a point-in-time identity comparison, not a guarantee against hostile path replacement after the query. The implementation and contract explicitly preserve that limit.
The source alias-write corruption and SIGBUS behavior is deliberately not reproduced. It remains a documented checked-error safety correction, not a claim of identical destructive process behavior.

Owner reports both 517-case helper and 188-case executable focused replays passed, with 117 MSVC / 118 GNU complete outputs, SDK ABI checks and six core identity scenarios. The reviewer did not execute those runs or certify the later full lint/debug/release validation.
This receipt supersedes the open finding in independent-cli-review-v1.json while retaining that historical review. Later source modifications need their own reviewed identity delta.
